content:
Ready for a full Class 4 Maths Olympiad rehearsal? A real IMO or SOF paper mixes every chapter — numbers, factors, fractions, decimals, money, measurement, time, geometry, perimeter and area, patterns and data handling — in one 30-question set. This free test gives a 10-question taste, and the practice-papers e-book gives you 25 complete Maths Olympiad Class 4 sample papers with answers.

What a Class 4 IMO sample paper looks like

  • 30 questions in one paper, balanced across all 11 chapters
  • A mix of number work, factors, fractions, decimals, money, measurement, time, geometry and data
  • An answer key and step-by-step solution for every question
  • Graded intermediate to hard, just like the real SOF Olympiad

How to use Class 4 Olympiad practice papers

  • Sit one paper in a quiet 30–40 minute slot, no help
  • Mark it with the answer key, then read the solution for every wrong one
  • Note which chapter the mistakes cluster in and revise that chapter
  • Repeat weekly — steady practice beats last-minute cramming

quiz.title: IMO Class 4 Maths Mixed Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten questions from across the syllabus. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.
quiz.about: IMO Maths Olympiad Class 4: all chapters

questions.q: A newspaper prints the crowd of 2,64,718 rounded to the nearest 1,000. Which number appears?
questions.explanation: 2,64,718 lies between 2,64,000 and 2,65,000; it is nearer to 2,65,000, so it rounds to 2,65,000.

questions.q: A gardener has 36 rose plants and 54 lily plants. He plants them in rows so that every row has the same number of plants and only one kind of plant. What is the greatest possible number of plants in each row?
questions.explanation: The row size must divide 36 and also 54. The greatest such number is the HCF of 36 and 54 = 18.

questions.q: What is the sum of 3/11 and 5/11?
questions.explanation: The denominators are the same, so add the numerators: 3 + 5 = 8, giving 8/11.

questions.q: School shoes are marked Rs 1290, and a festival offer takes Rs 195 off the price. What is the price after the discount?
questions.explanation: Price paid = marked price - discount = Rs 1290 - Rs 195 = Rs 1095.

questions.q: The distance between Riya's house and her school is 3475 m. Express this distance in kilometres and metres.
A train leaves at 10:40 pm. After 3 h 30 min, at what time will it reach its destination?
questions.explanation: 10:40 pm + 3 h 30 min crosses midnight, so the answer is 2:10 am the next day.

questions.q: The two strokes of the capital letter X are the best example of
questions.explanation: The strokes of X cross each other at a point — they are intersecting lines.

questions.q: A veranda measuring 18 m by 12 m is to be covered fully with square tiles of side 3 m. How many tiles are needed?
questions.explanation: Floor area = 18 × 12 = 216 sq m. One tile covers 3 × 3 = 9 sq m. Tiles needed = 216 ÷ 9 = 24.
The pattern adds 7 each time, so the missing term is 23.
